risk_note: F1-11a (orchestrator D10-1225, planning/05 F1-11 doable part). H5 landing share page replaces the placeholder: reads link_id from /<link_id>, calls getSharePage (anonymous, X-App-Id, X-Platform h5, X-App-Version from apps/h5/package.json inlined at build time), shows the shared product card and the quote time (only when degraded, BR-PRICE-11), buy link to jump_url, copy-token via POST tpwd only outside WeChat when tpwd_ticket is non-null (re-fetches the page once for a fresh ticket on 20001 ticket expiry), open-in-app only outside WeChat when open_in_app_url is non-null, WeChat shows the open-in-browser hint only; 30102 / 30111 sharer_auth_invalid and 30144 show one expired state without purchase or authorization; network failure can retry. Missing build config keeps the old placeholder shell. No download entry, no download guide page, no domain monitoring. Plain DOM, own fetch and media-origin allowlist inside the landing entry (no bridge-sdk, landing first screen within the 60 KiB budget). Dictionary keys only; two borrowed keys (link_landing.invalid, earnings.as_of) pending content keys. Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh); Codex spec-test r1 pass; red on couli-ci (20 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds: final tree fast (verify-fast/4) and browser (browser/3) green on couli-ci, run.ts static 10/10. Codex general review r1 fail (S1 missing X-App-Version, S2 stale tpwd ticket not refreshed) -> r2 pass. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex general r1 fail (S1 X-App-Version, S2 tpwd ticket refresh) -> r2 pass, no findings

spec_test_review.note: Codex spec-test r1 pass (one out-of-scope S1: expired-state text pinned by structure only until the content key exists); tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
